assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: clean website hero background plate for a premium German metal-engineering brand. Primary request: Create a photorealistic dark industrial studio / precision metal workshop environment with no product in it, designed to sit behind a separately rendered interactive 3D mechanical assembly. Scene/backdrop: charcoal-black workbench or dark brushed metal floor in the lower third; a modern precision workshop in the far background with extremely soft, defocused vertical machinery silhouettes and a large frosted industrial window on the far right. Style/medium: cinematic high-end industrial product photography, restrained and realistic, not concept art. Composition/framing: wide landscape hero, eye-level slightly low camera, completely empty center-right foreground reserved for a large mechanical product, darker generous negative space on the left for white headline typography. Lighting/mood: controlled warm key reflection from upper left, cool soft window/rim light from right, deep blacks with subtle readable detail, natural highlight roll-off, shallow background depth of field. Color palette: graphite, black steel, muted warm gray, very subtle desaturated green-gray; no orange accent. Materials/textures: clean new workshop, subtle brushed steel and matte floor, no dirt, no heavy scratches. Constraints: background plate only; no product, no machine part, no people, no logo, no text, no UI, no labels, no watermark. The foreground surface and perspective must support placing a 3D object around the right-center. Keep the left 38 percent visually quiet and dark.
assets.visual_review: Geprüft: fotorealistische CNC-Werkstatt, dunkle ruhige Textzone links, heller industrieller Fensterrand rechts, freie Werkbank als glaubwürdige Bühne. Keine Personen, Produkte, Schrift, Logos oder UI.
assets.alt_text: Dunkle moderne Präzisionswerkstatt mit metallischer Werkbank und diffusem Fensterlicht.
